body.title: [v17.0/forgejo] fix(ui): proper use of modern components in org teams ui
body.body:
**Backport**: #14752

Fixes forgejo/forgejo#14750.

Regression as result of combining #14281 with #13943 and #13630.

Styles in modern `button.css` were never supposed to act as overrides of Fomantic styles, but in a few places during v17 devcycle they ended up doing that before they broke.

As currently `button.css` does not offer alternative to Fomantic's `tiny` buttons those were just reverted to be fully Fomantic governed.

|Change|Before|After|
|-|-|-|
|Fixed classes|![1abef](/attachments/6e7121d2-3b42-4010-b7b5-3d832dd9dc50)|![1aft](/attachments/7279c52f-9d59-4ae7-bbd5-18e533d013e7)|
|Reverted|![2abef](/attachments/f807bd12-96a1-40bf-b928-712162b2c696)|![2aft](/attachments/46f52e0b-71e6-4a82-897b-e1d8694bb078)|

Not needed, no stable v17 versions were published.

body.title: fix(api): delete the repository when a migration fails
body.body:
POST /api/v1/repos/migrate creates the repository with status "being
migrated" before it migrates. A deferred function was supposed to delete
it when the migration failed, but it checked `repo != nil`, and
`repo, err = migrations.MigrateRepository(...)` had already set `repo` to
nil on failure. The repository stayed behind, empty and stuck in "being
migrated", and a retry with the same name failed until someone deleted it.

The same deferred function also read `err` after `updateRepoUnits`
assigned it, so a failure there deleted a repository that had migrated
successfully while the API still answered 201.

The deferred function now only handles a panic; a failed migration
deletes the repository at the place it fails. The API also passes
OriginalURL, so the system notice for a failed migration names the
source instead of "Migrate repository from  failed".
